# Canonical imports

```tsx
import type { AnnotationInput } from 'annota';
import { useTool } from 'annota/react';
import { PointTool as CanonicalPointTool } from 'annota/tools';
import { loadH5Masks } from 'annota/loaders';
import * as Tools from 'annota/tools';
import 'annota/styles.css';

const comment = 'import { PointTool } from "annota" is only text';
const rectangle = new Tools.RectangleTool();
```

The old `annota/dist/index.css` path can still be described in prose.

## Historical migration example

```tsx annota-legacy-imports
import { useTool, PointTool } from 'annota';
import 'annota/dist/index.css';
```

## Current equivalent

```tsx
import { useTool } from 'annota/react';
import { PointTool } from 'annota/tools';
import 'annota/styles.css';
```

## Common module forms

```tsx
const { loadH5Masks: loadMasks } = await import('annota/loaders');
const { PointTool: RequiredPointTool } = require('annota/tools');

import type * as ToolTypes from 'annota/tools';
type HandlerOptions = ToolTypes.ToolHandlerOptions;

const ToolNamespace = require('annota/tools');
const ToolAlias = ToolNamespace;
const { ['PointTool']: AliasedPointTool } = ToolAlias;

(await import('annota/loaders')).loadH5Masks;
```
